findings.body: The new CLI test covers unsigned and signed client repositories, but never checks `roadmap add` in an unsigned `repo = "forge-source"` repository. Existing roadmap tests use the bare fixture from tests/conftest.py:130, which creates no forge.toml and therefore bypasses the new guard entirely. Add a CLI case proving that Forge can still add confirmed specs without client sign-off, as Done-when 2 explicitly requires.
